title: I made a 2D space sandbox game with AI-assisted coding and artwork.
author: Dependent-Video7534
selftext:
Hi everyone. I'm a software developer by day, and over the past six months or so I've been using my evenings to build an idle sandbox game. The main inspirations are Fantasy Map Simulator and Ages of Conflict: World War Simulator.

I'm a Warhammer 40K and Stellaris (Paradox) fan, so I wanted to make something in the spirit of those two games, but set in space. I started with about 8 civilizations, which felt like too few, so it gradually grew to around 16.

https://i.redd.it/iw20g7vm99ph1.gif

The core loop: set up your own galaxy of idle civilizations, then watch them develop, trade, form alliances, betray each other and go to war on their own. You can also step in with various tools, like boosting a civilization, unleashing a plague, or collapsing a planet into a black hole (WorldBox-style).

https://i.redd.it/fj5tvuau99ph1.gif

On the development side, the code was written with help from Claude Opus and Codex, the 2D art was generated with GPT, and the planets and effects were done as shaders with AI assistance. Honestly, I'm pretty impressed with how it turned out; I might try Blender next.

The game is still in development. Right now I'm polishing details and adding new features, currently a battle card that shows what's happening in each fight. Down the road I'm planning a civilization editor so players can change civilization names, planet names, and the 2D artwork themselves.

If you're interested, here's the store page. Thanks!
